body.en: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental function \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical equations, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the solution set, requiring a final domain check against the original equation.
body.ar: Domain Restrictions, Invertibility & Asymptotic Behavior: An algebraic or transcendental الدالة \(f: D \to R\) possesses an inverse \(f^{-1}: R \to D\) if and only if \(f\) is strictly one-to-one (bijective) on \(D\), guaranteeing that \(\text{dom}(f^{-1}) = \text{ran}(f)\) and \(\text{ran}(f^{-1}) = \text{dom}(f)\). For logarithmic and radical المعادلات, every algebraic step that squares both sides or combines logs (\(\log_b u + \log_b v = \log_b(uv)\)) can enlarge the الحل set, requiring a final المجال check against the original المعادلة.

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the range to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).
body.ar:

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the المدى to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).

body.en:
Problem (Medium): The function \(f\) is defined for \(x \in \mathbb{R}\) by \[ f(x) = 3x + k, \] where \(k\) is a constant. The function \(g\) is defined for \(x \in \mathbb{R}\) by \[ g(x) = |x - 4|. \] Given that \(f^{-1}(4) = 2\), find the value of \(k\) and all real solutions to the equation \(f^{-1}(x) = g(x)\).

Step-by-Step Solution: 1. **Find the parameter \(k\):** By the definition of an inverse function, \(f^{-1}(4) = 2 \iff f(2) = 4\). Substituting \(x = 2\) into \(f(x)\): \[ f(2) = 3(2) + k = 6 + k \] \[ 6 + k = 4 \implies k = -2 \] 2. **Determine the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\):** With \(k = -2\), \(f(x) = 3x - 2\). Setting \(y = 3x - 2\) and solving for \(x\): \[ 3x = y + 2 \implies x = \frac{y + 2}{3} \] Thus, \(f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{x + 2}{3}\). 3. **Solve the equation \(f^{-1}(x) = g(x)\):** \[ \frac{x + 2}{3} = |x - 4| \iff x + 2 = 3|x - 4| \] Since the right-hand side is non-negative, any solution must satisfy \(x + 2 \ge 0 \implies x \ge -2\). - **Case 1 (\(x \ge 4\)):** Here, \(|x - 4| = x - 4\): \[ x + 2 = 3(x - 4) \implies x + 2 = 3x - 12 \implies 2x = 14 \implies x = 7 \] Since \(7 \ge 4\), \(x = 7\) is a valid solution. - **Case 2 (\(x < 4\)):** Here, \(|x - 4| = -(x - 4) = 4 - x\): \[ x + 2 = 3(4 - x) \implies x + 2 = 12 - 3x \implies 4x = 10 \implies x = \frac{5}{2} \] Since \(\frac{5}{2} = 2.5 < 4\) and \(2.5 \ge -2\), \(x = \frac{5}{2}\) is also a valid solution. **Common Traps:** - Choice B ignores the branch \(x < 4\), missing the second intersection point. - Choice C mistakenly computes \(k\) assuming \(f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x + k}{3} = 2 \implies k = 2\). - Choice D makes a sign error when expanding \(3(4 - x)\).
body.ar:
Problem (Medium): The الدالة \(f\) is defined for \(x \in \mathbb{R}\) by \[ f(x) = 3x + k, \] حيث \(k\) is a الثابت. The الدالة \(g\) is defined for \(x \in \mathbb{R}\) by \[ g(x) = |x - 4|. \] بما أن \(f^{-1}(4) = 2\), أوجد قيمة \(k\) and all real الحلول to the المعادلة \(f^{-1}(x) = g(x)\).

Step-by-Step الحل: 1. **أوجد المعامل \(k\):** By the definition of an inverse الدالة, \(f^{-1}(4) = 2 \iff f(2) = 4\). Substituting \(x = 2\) into \(f(x)\): \[ f(2) = 3(2) + k = 6 + k \] \[ 6 + k = 4 \implies k = -2 \] 2. **حدّد inverse الدالة \(f^{-1}(x)\):** With \(k = -2\), \(f(x) = 3x - 2\). Setting \(y = 3x - 2\) and solving for \(x\): \[ 3x = y + 2 \implies x = \frac{y + 2}{3} \] وعليه, \(f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{x + 2}{3}\). 3. **حل المعادلة \(f^{-1}(x) = g(x)\):** \[ \frac{x + 2}{3} = |x - 4| \iff x + 2 = 3|x - 4| \] Since the right-hand side is non-negative, any الحل must satisfy \(x + 2 \ge 0 \implies x \ge -2\). - **Case 1 (\(x \ge 4\)):** Here, \(|x - 4| = x - 4\): \[ x + 2 = 3(x - 4) \implies x + 2 = 3x - 12 \implies 2x = 14 \implies x = 7 \] Since \(7 \ge 4\), \(x = 7\) is a valid الحل. - **Case 2 (\(x < 4\)):** Here, \(|x - 4| = -(x - 4) = 4 - x\): \[ x + 2 = 3(4 - x) \implies x + 2 = 12 - 3x \implies 4x = 10 \implies x = \frac{5}{2} \] Since \(\frac{5}{2} = 2.5 < 4\) and \(2.5 \ge -2\), \(x = \frac{5}{2}\) is also a valid الحل. **Common Traps:** - Choice B ignores the branch \(x < 4\), missing the second التقاطع point. - Choice C mistakenly computes \(k\) assuming \(f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x + k}{3} = 2 \implies k = 2\). - Choice D makes a sign error عندما expanding \(3(4 - x)\).

body.en:
Problem (Hard): The function \( f \) is defined by \[ f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 13 \quad \text{for } x \ge 3. \] Determine the complete set of real values of the constant \( k \) for which the equation \[ f^{-1}(x) = |2x - k| \] has exactly one real solution.

Step-by-Step Solution: 1. **Find \( f^{-1}(x) \) and its domain:** Completing the square gives \[ f(x) = (x - 3)^2 + 4. \] For the domain \( x \ge 3 \), \( f(x) \) is strictly increasing with range \( [4, \infty) \). Setting \( y = (x - 3)^2 + 4 \) with \( x \ge 3 \) yields \( x - 3 = \sqrt{y - 4} \), so \[ f^{-1}(x) = 3 + \sqrt{x - 4}, \quad \text{with domain } x \ge 4. \] 2. **Set up the equation \( f^{-1}(x) = |2x - k| \):** Let \( u = \sqrt{x - 4} \ge 0 \), which implies \( x = u^2 + 4 \ge 4 \). The equation becomes \( 3 + u = |2(u^2 + 4) - k| = |2u^2 + 8 - k| \). 3. **Analyze Case A (Right branch: \( 2u^2 + 8 - k \ge 0 \)):** \[ 3 + u = 2u^2 + 8 - k \implies 2u^2 - u + (5 - k) = 0. \] Note that \( k = 2u^2 - u + 5 \), so the condition \( 2u^2 + 8 - k \ge 0 \) becomes \( 2u^2 + 8 - (2u^2 - u + 5) = u + 3 \ge 0 \), which holds for all \( u \ge 0 \). The discriminant of this quadratic is \[ \Delta_A = (-1)^2 - 4(2)(5 - k) = 8k - 39. \] - If \( k < \frac{39}{8} \), \( \Delta_A < 0 \): no real roots. - If \( k = \frac{39}{8} \), \( \Delta_A = 0 \): one repeated root \( u = \frac{1}{4} > 0 \), giving 1 solution. - If \( k > \frac{39}{8} \), the roots are \( u = \frac{1 \pm \sqrt{8k - 39}}{4} \). The larger root \( u_1 = \frac{1 + \sqrt{8k - 39}}{4} \) is strictly positive for all \( k > \frac{39}{8} \). The smaller root \( u_2 = \frac{1 - \sqrt{8k - 39}}{4} \ge 0 \iff \sqrt{8k - 39} \le 1 \iff 8k - 39 \le 1 \iff k \le 5 \). Thus, Case A yields: - 2 distinct non-negative solutions when \( \frac{39}{8} < k \le 5 \). - 1 non-negative solution when \( k > 5 \). 4. **Analyze Case B (Left branch: \( 2u^2 + 8 - k < 0 \)):** \[ 3 + u = -(2u^2 + 8 - k) = k - 2u^2 - 8 \implies 2u^2 + u + (11 - k) = 0. \] Similarly, \( k = 2u^2 + u + 11 \), so \( 2u^2 + 8 - k = -u - 3 < 0 \) holds for all \( u \ge 0 \). The roots are \( u = \frac{-1 \pm \sqrt{8k - 87}}{4} \). For \( u \) to be non-negative, we require the larger root to satisfy \[ \frac{-1 + \sqrt{8k - 87}}{4} \ge 0 \iff \sqrt{8k - 87} \ge 1 \iff 8k - 87 \ge 1 \iff k \ge 11. \] Thus, Case B yields: - 0 non-negative solutions when \( k < 11 \). - 1 non-negative solution when \( k \ge 11 \). 5. **Synthesize the total number of solutions:** - \( k < \frac{39}{8} \): 0 solutions. - \( k = \frac{39}{8} \): 1 solution (from Case A). - \( \frac{39}{8} < k \le 5 \): 2 solutions (both from Case A). - \( 5 < k < 11 \): 1 solution (from Case A). - \( k \ge 11 \): 2 solutions (1 from Case A and 1 from Case B). Therefore, there is exactly one real solution if and only if \( k = \frac{39}{8} \) or \( 5 < k < 11 \).
body.ar:
Problem (Hard): The الدالة \( f \) is defined by \[ f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 13 \quad \text{for } x \ge 3. \] حدّد complete set of real values of the الثابت \( k \) for which the المعادلة \[ f^{-1}(x) = |2x - k| \] has exactly one real الحل.

Step-by-Step الحل: 1. **Find \( f^{-1}(x) \) and its المجال:** Completing the square gives \[ f(x) = (x - 3)^2 + 4. \] For the المجال \( x \ge 3 \), \( f(x) \) is strictly increasing with المدى \( [4, \infty) \). Setting \( y = (x - 3)^2 + 4 \) with \( x \ge 3 \) yields \( x - 3 = \sqrt{y - 4} \), so \[ f^{-1}(x) = 3 + \sqrt{x - 4}, \quad \text{with domain } x \ge 4. \] 2. **Set up the المعادلة \( f^{-1}(x) = |2x - k| \):** Let \( u = \sqrt{x - 4} \ge 0 \), which implies \( x = u^2 + 4 \ge 4 \). The المعادلة becomes \( 3 + u = |2(u^2 + 4) - k| = |2u^2 + 8 - k| \). 3. **Analyze Case A (Right branch: \( 2u^2 + 8 - k \ge 0 \)):** \[ 3 + u = 2u^2 + 8 - k \implies 2u^2 - u + (5 - k) = 0. \] Note that \( k = 2u^2 - u + 5 \), so the condition \( 2u^2 + 8 - k \ge 0 \) becomes \( 2u^2 + 8 - (2u^2 - u + 5) = u + 3 \ge 0 \), which holds for all \( u \ge 0 \). The discriminant of this quadratic is \[ \Delta_A = (-1)^2 - 4(2)(5 - k) = 8k - 39. \] - If \( k < \frac{39}{8} \), \( \Delta_A < 0 \): no real roots. - If \( k = \frac{39}{8} \), \( \Delta_A = 0 \): one repeated root \( u = \frac{1}{4} > 0 \), giving 1 الحل. - If \( k > \frac{39}{8} \), the roots are \( u = \frac{1 \pm \sqrt{8k - 39}}{4} \). The larger root \( u_1 = \frac{1 + \sqrt{8k - 39}}{4} \) is strictly positive for all \( k > \frac{39}{8} \). The smaller root \( u_2 = \frac{1 - \sqrt{8k - 39}}{4} \ge 0 \iff \sqrt{8k - 39} \le 1 \iff 8k - 39 \le 1 \iff k \le 5 \). وعليه, Case A yields: - 2 distinct non-negative الحلول عندما \( \frac{39}{8} < k \le 5 \). - 1 non-negative الحل عندما \( k > 5 \). 4. **Analyze Case B (Left branch: \( 2u^2 + 8 - k < 0 \)):** \[ 3 + u = -(2u^2 + 8 - k) = k - 2u^2 - 8 \implies 2u^2 + u + (11 - k) = 0. \] Similarly, \( k = 2u^2 + u + 11 \), so \( 2u^2 + 8 - k = -u - 3 < 0 \) holds for all \( u \ge 0 \). The roots are \( u = \frac{-1 \pm \sqrt{8k - 87}}{4} \). For \( u \) to be non-negative, we require the larger root to satisfy \[ \frac{-1 + \sqrt{8k - 87}}{4} \ge 0 \iff \sqrt{8k - 87} \ge 1 \iff 8k - 87 \ge 1 \iff k \ge 11. \] وعليه, Case B yields: - 0 non-negative الحلول عندما \( k < 11 \). - 1 non-negative الحل عندما \( k \ge 11 \). 5. **Synthesize the total number of الحلول:** - \( k < \frac{39}{8} \): 0 الحلول. - \( k = \frac{39}{8} \): 1 الحل (from Case A). - \( \frac{39}{8} < k \le 5 \): 2 الحلول (both from Case A). - \( 5 < k < 11 \): 1 الحل (from Case A). - \( k \ge 11 \): 2 الحلول (1 from Case A and 1 from Case B). وبالتالي, there is exactly one real الحل if and only if \( k = \frac{39}{8} \) or \( 5 < k < 11 \).

label.en: ⚠️ Cambridge 9709 Traps — Modulus Inequalities & Extraneous Solutions
label.ar: ⚠️ Cambridge 9709 Traps — Modulus المتباينات & Extraneous الحلول

body.en:
Squaring Both Sides: When solving an inequality with moduli on both sides, such as \(|ax+b| < |cx+d|\), squaring both sides is fully valid because both quantities are non-negative: \((ax+b)^2 < (cx+d)^2\). This quickly reduces to a standard quadratic inequality.

Single Modulus Pitfall: Do NOT square both sides if one side can be negative (e.g. \(|2x-1| > x - 3\)). Squaring can introduce extraneous solutions or flip inequality signs unpredictably. Instead, sketch the linear graphs or split into two linear cases: \(2x-1 > x-3\) and \(2x-1 < -(x-3)\).
body.ar:
Squaring Both Sides: عندما solving an المتباينة with moduli on both sides, such as \(|ax+b| < |cx+d|\), squaring both sides is fully valid because both quantities are non-negative: \((ax+b)^2 < (cx+d)^2\). This quickly reduces to a standard quadratic المتباينة.

Single Modulus Pitfall: Do NOT square both sides if one side can be negative (e.g. \(|2x-1| > x - 3\)). Squaring can introduce extraneous الحلول or flip المتباينة signs unpredictably. Instead, sketch the linear graphs or split into two linear cases: \(2x-1 > x-3\) and \(2x-1 < -(x-3)\).

solution.en:
Since both sides are non-negative, square both sides:

\[(3x - 2)^2 < (x + 6)^2\]\[9x^2 - 12x + 4 < x^2 + 12x + 36\]\[8x^2 - 24x - 32 < 0\]\[x^2 - 3x - 4 < 0\]

Factor the quadratic:

\[(x - 4)(x + 1) < 0\]

The solution set is the interval between the roots:

\[-1 < x < 4\]

question.en: [Practice 3 · Easy] What are the values of \( x \) that satisfy the equation \[ |3x - 2| = 2|x + 1| \,? \]
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Functions: Modulus & Inverse): [Practice 3 · Easy] What are the values of \( x \) that satisfy the equation \[ |3x - 2| = 2|x + 1| \,? \]

hints.en: To solve the modulus equation \( |3x - 2| = 2|x + 1| \), we can either consider the linear cases or square both sides.
hints.ar: To حل the modulus equation \( |3x - 2| = 2|x + 1| \), we can either consider the linear cases or ربّع الطرفين.

hints.en: Method 1: Considering linear cases The equation \( |A| = |B| \) (where \( B = 2(x+1) \)) is equivalent to \( A = B \) or \( A = -B \): - Case 1:.

تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(4x^2 + 8x + 4\) ، \(5x^2 - 20x = 0 \implies 5x(x - 4) = 0\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
To solve the modulus equation \( |3x - 2| = 2|x + 1| \), we can either consider the linear cases or square both sides.

**Method 1: Considering linear cases**
The equation \( |A| = |B| \) (where \( B = 2(x+1) \)) is equivalent to \( A = B \) or \( A = -B \):
- Case 1:
\[ 3x - 2 = 2(x + 1) \implies 3x - 2 = 2x + 2 \implies x = 4 \]
- Case 2:
\[ 3x - 2 = -2(x + 1) \implies 3x - 2 = -2x - 2 \implies 5x = 0 \implies x = 0 \]

**Method 2: Squaring both sides**
Since both sides are non-negative, we can square both sides:
\[ (3x - 2)^2 = [2(x + 1)]^2 \]
\[ 9x^2 - 12x + 4 = 4(x^2 + 2x + 1) \]
\[ 9x^2 - 12x + 4 = 4x^2 + 8x + 4 \]
Subtracting \( 4x^2 + 8x + 4 \) from both sides gives:
\[ 5x^2 - 20x = 0 \implies 5x(x - 4) = 0 \]
Thus, \( x = 0 \) or \( x = 4 \).

**Misconceptions:**
- Choice B arises from a sign error when factoring \( 5x^2 - 20x = 0 \) as \( 5x(x + 4) = 0 \).
- Choice C arises from distributing the negative sign incorrectly as \( -(2x + 1) = -2x - 1 \) instead of \( -2(x + 1) = -2x - 2 \).
- Choice D arises from forgetting the factor of \( 2 \) on the right-hand side altogether.
solution.ar:
To حل the modulus equation \( |3x - 2| = 2|x + 1| \), we can either consider the linear cases or ربّع الطرفين.

**Method 1: Considering linear cases**
The equation \( |A| = |B| \) (حيث \( B = 2(x+1) \)) is equivalent to \( A = B \) or \( A = -B \):
- Case 1:
\[ 3x - 2 = 2(x + 1) \implies 3x - 2 = 2x + 2 \implies x = 4 \]
- Case 2:
\[ 3x - 2 = -2(x + 1) \implies 3x - 2 = -2x - 2 \implies 5x = 0 \implies x = 0 \]

**Method 2: Squaring both sides**
Since both sides are non-negative, we can ربّع الطرفين:
\[ (3x - 2)^2 = [2(x + 1)]^2 \]
\[ 9x^2 - 12x + 4 = 4(x^2 + 2x + 1) \]
\[ 9x^2 - 12x + 4 = 4x^2 + 8x + 4 \]
Subtracting \( 4x^2 + 8x + 4 \) from both sides gives:
\[ 5x^2 - 20x = 0 \implies 5x(x - 4) = 0 \]
وعليه، \( x = 0 \) or \( x = 4 \).

**Misconceptions:**
- Choice B arises from a sign error عندما حلّلing \( 5x^2 - 20x = 0 \) as \( 5x(x + 4) = 0 \).
- Choice C arises from distributing the negative sign incorrectly as \( -(2x + 1) = -2x - 1 \) instead of \( -2(x + 1) = -2x - 2 \).
- Choice D arises from forgetting the حلّل of \( 2 \) on the right-hand side altogether.

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
